assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
The claim/appeal pertains to episode ep-05019.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The submitted diagnosis codes include I49.5 and I48.0.
The note states there is a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction corresponds to diagnosis code Z86.73.
The note states continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management.
The claim is for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The denial is being appealed on medical necessity grounds / reconsideration is requested.
